text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Behold, Mira-ko, Sir Dants!
Behold this boundless, endless sea!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"The dawn of this country is at hand, zeyo!
Nyahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Daybreak... I don't really get it,
but I guess that's how it is~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
In other words... it's up to us to bring about the dawn,
right?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "Indeed! We shall bring about a new era!"

No Reason, Hishi Miracle, and Dants Flame
stood looking out at the sea near the training camp,
chatting together.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This spring was a season
of great leaps forward for us.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And furthermore—come this autumn!
We shall finally aim for supremacy under the heavens.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And so, right here and now, my resolution
for the autumn—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Shall we not compose a haiku about it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haiku, huh... Wonder if I can write a good one~
My grades in Japanese class aren't the greatest, though.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You have to include... seasonal words (kigo) and stuff,
right?
It all seems tricky, but I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Then first—it shall be me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "If I cannot win, I shall try until I do, little cuckoo."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I will not give up.
No matter what hardships stand in my way, never!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
As expected of No Reason-senpai.
Her resolve is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Then... next is my turn.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Though victory fades,
Keep taking flight through the sky,
O sweet cuckoo bird.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Lady Dants, are you... truly content not winning?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, of course I want to win.
I want to win, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't do that,
I want to make sure I never forget
the drive to keep on running.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is that so!
I see, I see!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so taking it easy like that is fine too.
In that case, I think I can do it too!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm!
Go ahead and recite it, Mirako.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If doing nothing
Brought victory, how sweet—
Cuckoo in the sky.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
*Faceplants!!* No matter how you slice it,
that's way too laid back!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well, I just figured this is what you really felt deep down.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen and all that was super rough~,
so I kinda wanna take it a bit easier."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, what are you saying?
That Takarazuka Kinen was merely a milestone for us.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Go beyond that and push even further ahead!
What's the point of tiring out at just this level?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's take on even more challenges!
Yeah! Let's take on even more challenges!

text_block_list.text: "Just showing one or two races with everything you've got isn't enough to overturn an era."

Putting on incredible race after incredible race time and time again—
only when you see that through for a whole year will the era truly be overturned.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Even better than that Takarazuka Kinen, huh?
You guys really are amazing, No Reason-chan, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Indeed. We'll have to... somehow keep up with them.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye! I shall lead the vanguard.
Let us advance together as a trinity from here on out!

Bathed in the summer sunlight,
No Reason's face beamed radiantly.
However...

A bit of summer foliage cast shadows
across Hishi Miracle and Dantsu Flame's faces.
